verdict.rationale: Cake explicitly advertises a 'flexible vesting engine' that automates cliffs, schedules, milestones, and pauses (cake-equity-docs-4), and its options feature page describes automated workflows for both NSO/ISO types (cake-equity-docs-5) and fast board approvals (cake-equity-docs-10), implying automatic tracking. However, there is no explicit mention of acceleration-on-exit clauses or a dedicated vested-vs-unvested tracking dashboard/report in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit acceleration-on-exit support, explicit vested/unvested reporting or dashboard evidence, independent/hands-on corroboration.
